	NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_colonial_slavery }
			NOT = {
				has_modifier = forced_slavery_ban
			}
			any_scope_state = {
				is_incorporated = no
			}
}

sg_law_available_law_canton_system = {

			NOT = {
				has_modifier = forced_market_opening
			}
			any_primary_culture = {
				has_discrimination_trait = heritage_han
			}

				state_region = s:STATE_GUANGDONG
				is_largest_state_in_region = yes
			}

		has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_traditionalism
	}

sg_law_available_law_isolationism = {
	NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_isolationism }
			NOT = {
				has_modifier = forced_market_opening
			}
			NOR = {
				AND = {
					any_primary_culture = {
						has_discrimination_trait = heritage_han
					}
					any_scope_state = {
						state_region = s:STATE_GUANGDONG
						is_largest_state_in_region = yes
					}
				}
				AND = {
					any_primary_culture = {
						cu:japanese = this
					}
					s:STATE_KYUSHU ?= {
						any_scope_state = {
							owner ?= ROOT
							is_largest_state_in_region = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
	NOT = {
		OR = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_laissez_faire
		}
	}
}
